change.item: Uses the canonical lowercase xdecaro\Core namespace for new Core integration code.
Registers all Notifications capabilities into Core 1.4 CapabilityRegistry when available.
Exposes the Notifications CoreIntegrationService from the booted component while preserving optional-Core fallback.

addition.item: Stable notification persistence, read/archive state, priorities, expiry and idempotent publishing.
Recipient/category/channel preferences with public service APIs.
Concurrency-safe delivery queue, retry lifecycle and immutable attempt history.
Native in-app channel and automatic plugin-based channel discovery.
Joomla Scheduled Tasks worker and maintenance routines.
Optional automatic email delivery through the Joomla mail configuration.
Standard xdecaro Information page with environment, integrations and diagnostics.
Installable package, update server, deterministic release artifacts and SHA-256 verification.
